newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Greenpeace blocks Austrian tunnel over EU traffic.
newsitem.headline: Greenpeace blocks Austrian tunnel over EU traffic.

text.p: Greenpeace activists blockaded the Tauern Alpine highway in southwestern Austria on Wednesday in protest at rising pollution from heavy trucks.
Around 80 protestors blocked both ends of a tunnel on the busy route between Salzburg and Munich in Germany.
Traffic quickly ground to a halt, causing long tailbacks, the Austrian automobile club OeAMTC reported.
"There was total chaos," it quoted a traffic official as saying.
Greenpeace said it would continue the protest until economy minister Johann Farnleiter was prepared to consider its demands for higher road tolls across Austria.
Austria is currently locked in a legal battle with the European Commission over the levels of tolls on the Brenner Alpine route in the southern Tyrol region.
Austria has been accused of breaching EU legislation by doubling the night toll for trucks to 2,300 schillings ($215) on the route through the Brenner Pass.

But Austria says the pass is an environmentally sensitive area which must be protected against increasing traffic, in particular from trucks and tourist vehicles which cut through the pass between Germany and Italy.
